matchupOfTheWeek.title: Pass Offense vs. Pass Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our pass offense grades in the 97th percentile against a unit that grades 71st — the widest real statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing about Week 2: we're staring down a Steelers team that's humming along nicely, but we've got something they can't game-plan for — a pass offense operating at the 97th percentile going up against a defense stuck at 71st in the rankings, which is genuinely the widest statistical mismatch on the board this week. Drake Maye getting to operate in that sweet spot is exactly what we need to bounce back from last week and start building some momentum at home. The Steelers have that recent win over us fresh in the memory (21-14, 2025), but our head-to-head history suggests we know how to handle them, and with TreVeyon Henderson ready to go after his ankle injury, we're getting healthier at exactly the right time. Sure, Pittsburgh's defense is no pushover at 14th overall, but our offensive firepower here is the story — this is our game to take.
